layers.title: Yellow taxi trips
layers.source: NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission · Yellow Taxi Trip Records, January 2025

facts.Sampling: Stratified random sample, balanced across 24 hours
facts.Trip geometry: Snapped to OpenStreetMap roads via OSRM v5
facts.Coordinates: Zone centroids from TLC taxi-zone shapefile (EPSG:2263 → WGS84)
facts.Format: .bin (custom CCM1, ~40% the size of JSON, parsed as typed arrays)

layers.notes: Each trail starts where a real taxi picked up and ends where it dropped off. The line in between is the actual driving route OSRM computed across OpenStreetMap.

layers.title: Traffic-based CO₂ heatmap
layers.source: NYC DOT · Automated Traffic Volume Counts (NYC Open Data)

facts.Emission factor: EPA fleet-mix (75 % car + 15 % light truck + 8 % heavy truck + 2 % bus → 558 g CO₂/mi)

layers.notes: Each station's hourly mean vehicle volume is converted to grams of CO₂ using the EPA fleet-mix factor. The heatmap interpolates between adjacent hour snapshots so it morphs continuously through the day instead of snapping on the hour.

layers.title: Air-quality monitors

facts.Intensity scale: Per-station 10th–90th percentile stretch (reveals each monitor's own daily cycle even when the absolute μg/m³ values are low)
facts.Absolute values shown: Stats panel reports the raw μg/m³ and ppb — unmodified.

layers.notes: EPA's regulated network has 5 NYC monitors at hourly resolution. PurpleAir's community-sensor network adds 50+ more outdoor sites for PM2.5, all rendered as halos on the map. Combined coverage is 10× the federal-only baseline.

layers.title: Basemap
layers.source: CARTO Dark Matter · MapLibre GL JS

facts.Engine: MapLibre GL JS 4.7 (open source, no token)

layers.notes: Replaced Mapbox in v8 to eliminate token + URL-restriction headaches for any visitor.
